remarks: Gorgeous multi-use country property with an established small-farm infrastructure offering a combination of residential, agricultural, and potentially commercial uses. 2nd photo is a virtual rendering. Barndominium Residence, Commercial Building (church) & Livestock Barn on nearly 5 Scenic Acres with two enclosed pastures along Buffalo Creek. Barndo-Residence central A/C almost 2,000 sq ft of living space, 4 bedrooms, 2 full baths with custom cabinetry, farmhouse sink, barn doors, quartz countertops, Bluetooth Surround stereo system. Rear deck overlooks 2 enclosed pastures to the creek. Stairs lead down to an enclosed dog run. Below the residence is nearly 2,000 sq ft of heated garage space perfect for car collection, toys or shop use. The “Pass Thru” overhead doors are convenient but also frame out one of the best views in WNY! —Commercial Building (church) is 3,456 square feet exploding with potential and once was the dream of converting to main residence. Featuring a new roof (2015), blown-in insulation (2017), A/C splits, and many other improvements geared towards the maximum functionality and opportunity of this space. This flexible commercial structure includes a retail entry area, main hall, administrative offices, two bathrooms, and a lower-level commercial kitchen with production and storage areas. A double-door walkout allows for efficient shipping and receiving and a generator power connection for quick access. The space offers exceptional flexibility for creative studios, workshops, events, or potential residential conversion (subject to Town approval). Livestock Structure (barn) out back designed with hemlock distressed look is newer built and has all of the conveniences you will need to run your farm through the year with electricity, water, insulated tack room/milk house, frost-free hydrant. Stalls open to an enclosed paddock then the two electric-fenced pastures along Buffalo Creek. Additional structures include a horse/goat shed overlooking the second pasture and a front tool shed for added storage and utility. Make your dream your reality in a property designed for space, freedom, and a lifestyle defined by possibility.
